svg.title: Default Azure Network Lab address allocation
svg.desc: Separate boxes show the managed virtual hub, Spoke1 service subnets, Spoke2 workload subnet, and Azure-hosted branch subnets. Reserved subnets do not imply their paid services are enabled.

Subnet presence ≠ service deployment • Azure live status: NOT RUN
